build_anchor_head_single: build a python module to instantiate AnchorHeadSingle for 3D object detection with anchor-based classification and box regression heads
create_forward_pass: create a forward pass through AnchorHeadSingle that predicts class scores and bounding boxes from 2D spatial features
test_init_weights: test the AnchorHeadSingle init_weights method to verify classification bias and box regression weight initialization
review_forward_method: review the AnchorHeadSingle forward method to understand how cls_preds, box_preds, and dir_cls_preds are generated and returned
refactor_direction_classifier: refactor the AnchorHeadSingle conv_dir_cls optional direction classifier to support configurable NUM_DIR_BINS values
